project.name: PillPrice launch
project.brief: Out of Pocket is expanding, fast, and is now running more big projects at once than any newsletter company should. This is one of them. This morning on the KnowledgeFest stage, Nikhil announced that OOP launches PillPrice, its first app, in 3 weeks. Employers give it to their employees, and it shows them the cheapest nearby pharmacy for their prescription. The date is not moving. The project tracker says things are mostly on track. Your job is to figure out what's really going on before launch day

notes.title: PillPrice launch sync
bullets: Spent the first 20 minutes on what "launched" means. Sam: it's in the app stores. Marisol: the press release is out. Tyler: a customer signed. Ken: someone got invoiced. Parked, will keep discussing in the L-1 comments
Launch date: Nikhil is announcing Nov 9 on stage at KnowledgeFest on Saturday. He picked it because "the 9th felt right." Nobody has checked it against the board
Pricing: Ken is waiting on Tyler, Tyler is waiting on Marisol, Marisol is waiting on Ken. Group agreed this is a great conversation to keep having
Legal: Priya couldn't make it. Her note says terms of service are 90% done. The last 10% is who's responsible if the app shows a wrong price. She says that part is the actual work
App stores: Sam will submit the Friday before launch. Rob asked how long approval takes. Sam: "usually a few days, unless they reject it, then you start over." Moved on
Engineering: Sam says on track. Rob asked what "p95 regressed" means. Sam said it's fine
Spanish version: Ken mentioned about a third of members use the app in Spanish. Translation isn't in anyone's budget. Marisol will fill in the ticket after kickoff. Kickoff was 7 weeks ago
QA: Sam moved it to Done since the plan is to test in production. No objections
Sales training stays on Fri Nov 6, the last workday before launch. Tyler will build the deck once there's a price
Customer support: not on the agenda
Action items: none assigned. Next sync TBD
